vtxVirtualization.limitationBody: This tool disables system-side Memory Integrity, VBS and Hyper-V auto-start, resolving most virtualization popups. However, different games/anti-cheats use different detection methods: ① BIOS VT-x/SVM may still need to be enabled manually; ② software relying on virtualization (VMware/VirtualBox/WSL2/Docker/emulators) may conflict; ③ Windows Update may reset system settings.

screenTest.deadPixelDesc: Solid colors fill the screen; look for bright, dark or always-colored pixels that do not change. Click or use arrow keys to switch color
screenTest.gradientDesc: A smooth black-to-white/color gradient. Visible steps (banding) indicate weak color transition or bit depth
screenTest.responseTimeDesc: A dark box moves fast across a mid-gray background. Judge response speed by trailing ghosting and overshoot; speed is adjustable
screenTest.refreshRateDesc: A sweeping bar with live FPS and frame-time stats to verify the panel reaches the configured refresh rate
screenTest.uniformityDesc: Pure black/white fullscreen to observe brightness and color differences at corners vs center (bleed or IPS Glow); grid overlay optional
screenTest.tearingDesc: Scrolling black/white bands with a vertical grid; look for horizontal misalignment, breaks or double images to spot vsync/refresh anomalies
screenTest.subpixelDesc: Pure R/G/B vertical stripes drawn per physical pixel; inspect subpixel order and density up close to calibrate ClearType/text rendering
screenTest.blackLevelDesc: Dark-gray blocks rising from pure black; how many you can distinguish reflects black level and shadow detail — merging the first blocks means lifted blacks or crushed shadows
screenTest.contrastStepsDesc: 20 even grayscale blocks from black to white with optional white/black border; more distinguishable steps mean better grayscale and contrast
screenTest.textClarityDesc: CJK + Latin sample lines at multiple sizes; check for soft edges or red/green fringing (poor subpixel rendering); invert to compare light/dark backgrounds
screenTest.geometryDesc: Fullscreen 1px horizontal/vertical grid plus two diagonals; look for wavy, bent or uneven lines to catch scaling/non-integer resolution distortion
screenTest.viewingAngleDesc: Identical gray/red/green/blue patches at the four corners and center; from head-on, judge whether hue and brightness stay consistent to assess off-angle color shift

systemOptimizer.pageDesc: Toggle system optimizations for better performance and privacy
systemOptimizer.noticeContent:
The optimizations on this page involve system-level modifications. Please review each feature carefully before use, do not blindly apply all of them, and choose the ones suitable for your device.

If you don't understand it, don't optimize! If you don't understand it, don't optimize! If you don't understand it, don't optimize!

If your FPS drops after optimization, we are not responsible.

The screen will briefly go black and return to normal within seconds. Administrator privileges are required.

Suitable for display anomalies, artifacts, stuttering, and applying GPU renames. Windows only. Administrator privileges required.
